summary: Decel Overrun Spark Activation (Row 100 in ECM 44605) & Cruising MAF Lean Bias Elimination (+3.0% at 0.90V-1.20V in ECM 12163)

changes.parameter_name: Spark Decel vs. RPM vs. ECT
changes.path: Engine / Spark / Advance / Transient / Spark Decel vs. RPM vs. ECT
changes.detail: Populates Row 4 (100 ECT) with target decel retard: 3,000 RPM (5.00 -> -2.00), 4,000 RPM (15.00 -> -4.00), 5,000 RPM (16.00 -> -4.00), 6,000 RPM (17.00 -> -4.00). Row 5 (200 ECT) retained at -2/-4/-4/-4. Columns <= 2,000 RPM untouched (5.0 deg / 12-14 deg) to preserve clutch-in anti-stall idle catch.
changes.rationale: Datalog v028 proved the PCM evaluates against Row 100 at operating temperature (180-195F / 82-90C). Populating Row 100 activates the commanded overrun exhaust burble/pops.

changes.path: Engine / Airflow / General / MAF Calibration / MAF Airflow vs. Voltage
changes.rationale: Datalog v028 showed an average +2.0% to +3.4% lean fuel trim bias in this voltage range (peaking at +3.36% in the 1.00-1.10V bin), causing wideband lambda lean excursions (1.14-1.18) and cruising stutter during light-throttle holds.
